# ai_dotfiles — onboarding

## 1. Goal

**What:** The single source of the owner's global AI-CLI setup: one rules file, per-CLI settings keys, shared MCP servers, pinned plugins, 39 skill folders (one, `git/`, a bundle of 8) and two hooked skills (worktree-guard, small-commits), applied to Claude Code, Codex CLI, Pi and Antigravity on the Mac, and to Claude Code cloud sessions. It also carries the owner's git flow (a worktree per task, `ship`, `approve`), a shared status line and a nightly daily-log pass.

**How:** `config/ai-clis.json` says which CLIs are on and where each reads things. `ai-dotfiles install` runs seven Python steps: link what is read-only (the rules file, every skill, the commands, Pi's extension), merge what a CLI writes back (settings keys, hook entries), add MCP servers and plugins through each CLI's own commands, and load a 04:00 LaunchAgent. Every write is validated, backed up, atomic and rolled back on failure. Hooks go through one adapter, `scripts/agent_hooks.py` (Pi: `agent_hooks.ts`). A cloud environment's setup script runs `install.sh --cloud` on the VM; a cloud session on this repo also links its skills at start. `ai-dotfiles check` compares live state with the repo; CI runs the unittest suites and shellcheck on every push; a weekly Action mirrors the CLIs' docs into `docs/upstream/` and opens a PR.

## 2. System design

**Shape:** one monolith of scripts and config, no frontend or API: a global command (`ai-dotfiles`), a second command (`daily-log`), hook scripts behind one adapter, a Pi extension, a LaunchAgent, a cloud setup script and two GitHub Actions workflows.

### Workflows

#### install — `ai-dotfiles install` (and `update`, `check`)

```text
desired state ──▶ installer ──▶ global files
                      ├──▶ MCP + plugins ──▶ receipt
                      ├──▶ hook files
                      └──▶ LaunchAgent
ai-dotfiles check ──▶ healthcheck ──▶ dry-run install (expect 0 changes)
```

- desired state (repo): CLIs on, their paths, every list — `config/ai-clis.json`, `scripts/install/installer.py:40`
- installer (repo): checks the config, then the seven steps in order; `update` fast-forwards `main` first; run from a worktree, every link still points at the main checkout — `scripts/install.sh:100`, `:67`, `scripts/install/installer.py:67`
- global files (home): rules file, skill folders and commands linked; settings keys merged — `scripts/install/instructions.py`, `scripts/install/skills.py`, `scripts/install/settings.py`
- MCP + plugins (CLIs): `<cli> mcp add` when missing; each plugin at its release tag through the CLI's own manager, dependencies checked, read back — `scripts/install/mcp.py`, `scripts/install/plugins.py:702`
- receipt (home): what the step installed vs. took over; uninstall leaves plugins in place — `scripts/install/plugins.py:508`
- hook files (home): one entry per event for worktree-guard and small-commits; the old daily-log nudge taken out — `scripts/install/hooks.py:64`, `:69`, `:51`
- LaunchAgent (home): plist running `daily-log day --write` at 04:00 — `scripts/install/launchd.py:41`, `:77`
- healthcheck (repo): dry-run install, `mcp list`, machine-path scan, tests; from a worktree, live state is measured against the main checkout — `scripts/healthcheck.sh:20`

#### cloud session — a session starts in the cloud environment

```text
environment.sh ──clone──▶ setup.sh ──▶ install --cloud ──▶ global files
                             └──▶ plugin clones ──▶ CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_DIRS
session start ──▶ cloud_session ──▶ rules ──▶ context
                        ├──▶ skill links
                        └──▶ PATH
```

- environment.sh (GitHub): pasted on claude.ai; clones this repo to `/opt/ai-dotfiles`, never fails the session — `scripts/cloud/environment.sh:8`
- setup.sh (repo): each step `ok` or `FAIL` in `/opt/ai-dotfiles-setup.txt` — `scripts/cloud/setup.sh:35`
- install --cloud (repo): Claude only; skills minus `config/cloud.json`'s `local_only`; small-commits alone; no plugins, no launchd — `scripts/install.sh:60`, `scripts/install/skills.py:68`, `scripts/install/hooks.py:74`
- plugin clones (repo): each Claude plugin at its tag into `/opt/ai-plugins`, then its own `cloud/setup.sh` — `scripts/cloud/setup.sh:59`, `:73`
- CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_DIRS (CLIs): the report's last line, set once on the environment — `scripts/cloud/setup.sh:82`
- session start (CLIs): `SessionStart` when `CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE` is true; a `PreToolUse` Bash hook runs small-commits — `.claude/settings.json`
- cloud_session (repo): fails open, a missing part becomes a line of context — `scripts/cloud_session.py:69`
- rules (repo): `config/global-agents.md` as `additionalContext` — `scripts/cloud_session.py:34`
- skill links (repo): relative links in `.claude/skills/`, gitignored; `reloadSkills` when any was made — `scripts/cloud_session.py:41`
- PATH (CLIs): `scripts/` first, through `CLAUDE_ENV_FILE` — `scripts/cloud_session.py:59`

#### task — first edit in a repo with the flow on, to `ship`, to `approve <n>`

```text
edit call ──▶ agent_hooks ──▶ guard route ──main checkout──▶ "name this work"
worktree new ──▶ claim ──▶ commits ──▶ ship ──▶ PR ──▶ approve
                                                         ├──▶ review
                                                         ├──▶ tag
                                                         ├──▶ merge
                                                         └──▶ prune
```

- edit call (CLIs): `PreToolUse` on edits and shell; Pi's `tool_call` — `scripts/agent_hooks.ts`
- agent_hooks (repo): CLI JSON in as an `Event`, reply out in that CLI's shape, fails open — `scripts/agent_hooks.py:121`, `:238`
- guard route (repo): only repos with `worktree-guard.flow true`; the main checkout and another session's worktree are refused — `skills/worktree-guard/scripts/worktree_guard.py:672`, `:211`
- worktree new (repo): fetches origin, makes `.claude/worktrees/<type>-<slug>` detached, no local branch; `worktree pr <n>` does the same on an open PR — `skills/worktree-guard/scripts/worktree_guard.py:1096`, `:1158`
- claim (home): first edit owns the worktree under a file lock; session end frees it and sweeps leftovers — `skills/worktree-guard/scripts/worktree_guard.py:494`, `:898`
- commits (repo): gated by small-commits (300 warn, 600 wall, trailers) — `skills/small-commits/scripts/small_commits.py:394`
- ship (repo): runs AGENTS.md's Verify block, pushes `<type>/<slug>` (or onto the PR's branch), opens or updates the PR, deletes the worktree — `skills/git/ship/scripts/ship.py:151`, `:55`
- PR (GitHub): waits for the person to say `approve <n>`
- approve (repo): `approve <n>` lands PR n from any session; bare `approve` adds preflight, push and PR for the branch checked out — `skills/git/approve/scripts/approve.py:91`, `:110`
- review (GitHub): approves as a second login, cached in `git config approve.reviewer` — `skills/git/approve-pr/scripts/approve_pr.py:53`, `:65`
- tag (GitHub): `archive/<name>` at the PR's head, pushed before the merge — `skills/git/archive-tag/scripts/archive_tag.py:69`
- merge (GitHub): a merge commit — `skills/git/merge-pr/scripts/merge_pr.py:24`
- prune (outside): remote branch deleted, main checkout fast-forwarded when safe, the work's worktree deleted last — `skills/git/prune-branch/scripts/prune_branch.py:169`, `skills/worktree-guard/scripts/worktree_guard.py:969`

#### day pass — LaunchAgent at 04:00

```text
launchd ──▶ day pass ──▶ sessions ──▶ evidence ──▶ claude -p ──▶ journal
```

- launchd (home): runs `~/.local/bin/daily-log day --write` — `scripts/install/launchd.py:77`
- day pass (repo): yesterday plus the days before, cut at 04:00 — `skills/daily-log/scripts/day_pass.py:200`
- sessions (home): every CLI's transcripts in the window, scratch folders dropped — `scripts/agent_sessions.py:83`
- evidence (repo): per day, sessions and repo facts, existing entries — `skills/daily-log/scripts/day_pass.py:161`
- claude -p (CLIs): one Sonnet session allowed only `daily-log add` — `skills/daily-log/scripts/day_pass.py:54`, `:190`
- journal (outside): one entry per project per day — `skills/daily-log/LOG-FORMAT.md`

## 3. Conventions

- Files: Python modules and tests in snake_case, one `test_<script>.py` per script; shell scripts and config in kebab-case; each skill a folder with `SKILL.md`, its code in `skills/<name>/scripts/`.
- Code: direct imports by path, no injection; hook scripts supply `decide(event, state)` to `agent_hooks`; install steps plan `(path, before, after)` changes, `installer.show`, then `installer.apply`; git steps share `git_run` (`step`, `act` with `dry`, `Stop`). Subprocesses run synchronously.
- Errors: shell under `set -euo pipefail` (`scripts/install.sh:30`); install steps raise `ValueError` naming the path; git steps raise `Stop` with the next action, and a cleanup they cannot do safely is a `skipped:` line. Hooks and the cloud setup fail open: exit 0, say what is missing.
- Tests: load each script by path, temporary `HOME` and state folder (`scripts/tests/support.py`); guard and git tests use real temporary repos with a bare origin.
- Git: conventional subjects with a scope (`feat(cloud): …`), under 300 lines a commit, with Why:/Scope:/Verified: trailers; one worktree per task, pushed as `<type>/<slug>` by `ship`; PRs merged by merge commit after a second-login approval. A landing leaves only an `archive/<name>` tag (30 so far). `main` plus `upstream-sync`, force-pushed weekly.

## 4. Common tasks

- Test: `python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests`
- Lint: `shellcheck scripts/*.sh scripts/cloud/*.sh scripts/ai-dotfiles`
- Preview an install: `bash scripts/install.sh --dry-run` (zero changes on a configured Mac)
- Check live state: `bash scripts/healthcheck.sh`, or `ai-dotfiles check`
- Install, update, uninstall: `ai-dotfiles install`, `ai-dotfiles update`, `ai-dotfiles uninstall`
- One step: `python3 scripts/install/<step>.py --dry-run`, `--uninstall`, `--target <cli>`
- Cloud VM install, by hand: `bash scripts/install.sh --cloud --dry-run`
- Start a task: `ai-dotfiles worktree new <type>/<slug>`; fix a PR: `ai-dotfiles worktree pr <n>`; see them: `ai-dotfiles worktree list`
- Finish: `ai-dotfiles ship --title "…" --body-file <file>`; land: `ai-dotfiles approve <n>`
- Day pass by hand: `daily-log day` (evidence only), `daily-log day --write`
